Selective Distillation for Open Vocabulary Segmentation
Zheng Li, Marco Rossi, Anne Dubois
In this paper, we introduce Selective-distillation, a framework for open vocabulary segmentation that transfers knowledge from a frozen vision language model. Unlike prior methods, our approach keeps the text encoder fixed, which is simpler and, as we show, sufficient. We evaluate on five benchmarks and report consistent improvements, notably on rare classes and small objects.
